notes: Prints the active Jira account state (Authenticated flag, Site, Email, Authentication Type). Read-only GET; no local file or remote Jira mutation. Output DOES contain Tier A/B identifiers (site host + account email) — redact before pasting into committed artifacts. Sibling acli jira auth login/logout/switch MUTATE local credential state; scope auto-approve to the status leaf, never acli jira auth *.

Lists attachments for one work item via read-only GET (verified via acli jira workitem attachment list --help). EVERY flag in this leaf is read-only: --key <KEY> (selector), --json (format), -h/--help. No write/upload/delete flag exists, so all forms are SAFE. Sibling leaves attachment create/remove are NOT yet vetted — treat as UNKNOWN until probed. Output may carry attachment filenames/URLs — Tier B org content; redact before committing. Same family caution as workitem list row: never auto-approve bare acli *.

Lists comments for one work item via read-only GET; returns the paginated envelope {comments,isLast,maxResults,startAt,total} with each comment carrying author/body/id/visibility. EVERY flag in this leaf is read-only (verified via --help): --key <KEY> (selector), --limit <int> (page size, default 50), --order <created|updated> (default +created), --paginate, --json, -h/--help. No write/edit/delete flag exists, so all forms are SAFE. Sibling MUTATES leaves: comment create, comment update, comment delete (destructive) — never auto-approve acli jira workitem comment *. comment visibility reads visibility options but is NOT vetted; treat as UNKNOWN. Caveat: --paginate IGNORES --limit and walks every page (unbounded output — redirect to a file per shell-execution-rules 2.3.4). Output carries comment bodies + author display names (Tier B org content; no emails/accountIds observed) — redact before committing.

OTHER acli subcommands MUTATE remote Jira state: workitem create/edit/transition/assign/clone/archive/delete, comment create, field create.
